description:
Delve into this NOT single life Trial (you have infinite lives in this Trial), where you're tasked with completing every vanilla dungeon entirely SOLO. You may never die, but that doesn't mean the bosses you're tasked with slaying become any easier to defeat. In order to overcome this Trial, you'll need expert techniques, and heaps of patience. The question isn't 'if you'll survive', but will you overcome what lies before you?
